limitations: This is a configuration bridge for the two current clan labels. Membership is detected from the existing styled display name, including operators.
New clans, renamed labels and changed colors require regenerating the bridge until the prepared full-name SimpleClans code is activated.
The absent-clan fallback preserves native display names and will use full names automatically after that code update.
The WestGiggas template is configured but its member was offline during native parsing checks.
